collections.title: app lab
collections.blurb: Small native tools that do one thing properly.

projects.title: Slate – Text Scratchpad
projects.pitch: A two-pane scratchpad in a single HTML file.
projects.image_alt: Slate's two-pane scratchpad with a live diff.
projects.description: Two panes, a live word-level diff, autosave and a markdown preview — all in one HTML file. Open it from anywhere and your text stays on your machine; there is no install, account or network call.
projects.note: No network calls. Nothing you type or paste leaves your machine.

projects.title: EyeQ – Save your Eyes
projects.pitch: A menu-bar break reminder that enforces the 20-20-20 rule.
projects.description: A menu-bar reminder for the 20-20-20 rule: every twenty minutes, look six metres away for twenty seconds. EyeQ pauses when you step away, waits during calls and full-screen work, and can enforce a harder break when you need it.
projects.note: Signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple; opens normally. Requires macOS 13 or later.
projects.download_pending_message: EyeQ is notarized and published from the home Mac. The download will work once that release is uploaded.

secondary.label: Release notes
secondary.pending_message: Release notes appear with the published build.

projects.title: Slimage – Image Shrinker
projects.pitch: Batch-convert PNG and JPG to WebP, AVIF or HEIC.
projects.image_alt: Slimage converting a folder of images.
projects.description: Drag in images or whole folders, pick WebP, AVIF or HEIC, and set the quality. Slimage writes the results beside the originals or into a folder you choose, handling transparency and EXIF orientation along the way.
projects.note: Signed and notarized. Requires macOS 14 or later; Apple silicon and Intel.
projects.download_pending_message: Slimage is notarized and published from the home Mac. The download will work once that release is uploaded.

secondary.label: Release notes
secondary.pending_message: Release notes appear with the published build.

projects.wp_image_note: This is the old WebP Hero screenshot; replace it with a current Slimage capture.

projects.title: DTX – Draw Things Browser
projects.pitch: Browse Draw Things projects and export the images at full quality.
projects.image_alt: DTX browsing a Draw Things project.
projects.description: Open a Draw Things project and browse every generation with its prompt, model, seed and settings. Export selected images as lossless PNGs — the stored tensors, not the preview JPEGs — with optional prompt sidecars.
projects.note: Signed and notarized. On first use, macOS may ask for access to your Draw Things folder.
projects.download_pending_message: DTX is notarized and published from the home Mac. The download will work once that release is uploaded.

secondary.label: Release notes
secondary.pending_message: Release notes appear with the published build.

projects.title: PixelBuddy – Measure & Pick
projects.pitch: Measure on-screen spacing and sample colours as hex.
projects.description: Freeze the screen, drag to measure a gap, or pick a pixel and get #RRGGBB on the clipboard. CSS pixels or device pixels, edge snapping, and a history of recent measurements, all from the menu bar.
projects.note: Signed and notarized. Needs Screen Recording permission; the capture is held in memory only while a session is open.
projects.download_pending_message: PixelBuddy is notarized and published from the home Mac. The download will work once that release is uploaded.

projects.title: ShredR – Browser Snowboarding
projects.pitch: An endless low-poly snowboarding game in the browser.
projects.image_alt: ShredR snowboarding down a low-poly mountain.
projects.description: An endless low-poly downhill: carve through powder, dodge trees, launch kickers and slide rails. Keyboard on desktop, touch or tilt on an iPad — no install, no account, just the browser.
projects.note: Tilt steering needs HTTPS and motion permission on iPad; touch always works.

collections.title: daily drop
collections.blurb: Small automations that arrive in your inbox.

projects.title: MekoWeather – Local Weather
projects.pitch: A local forecast in your inbox every morning.
projects.description: A clean local forecast in your inbox each morning: today's range, rain, wind and what to wear. Built as a small n8n automation, so there is no app to install.
projects.note: Request an invite and I'll add you to the next send.

projects.title: CatADay – A Cat in your Inbox
projects.description: One cat, every morning. A daily email that picks a cat from the archive and sends it with a short note — no feed, no algorithm, no app.
